Platinum white hair, mid-length and swept back with a few stray strands. Golden yellow eyes with a sharp, piercing expression. Appears in the early twenties with a mature, stern facial structure. Lean and athletic build. Wears a high-collared black and deep purple ornate robe with gold trim. Possesses a small, singular dark horn protruding from the forehead.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
